title: Boulevard Stays - 1BR, Steps to Broadway, Ryman
description:
Walk to it all. You'll sit minutes from the Ryman, Bridgestone Arena, the Country Music Hall of Fame, and the full Honky Tonk Highway—then drop into a quiet, design-forward apartment that's all yours. No crowded lobby, no elevators full of bachelorette parties. Just Music City at your door and a real place to sleep. Our apartments offer self check-in at 4pm, guest support by text, phone and a Virtual Front Desk through your mobile device.

The space
SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT:
- Bedroom: 1 queen-size bed (sleeps 2)
- Living area: 1 sofa bed (sleeps 2) + 1 queen-size air-mattress (sleeps 2)

LIVING SPACE:
- Full kitchen with dishes, cookware and dishwasher
- Coffee and tea
- Free high-speed Wi-Fi
- In-unit laundry
- Comfortable dining table for WFH meetings or studying needs
- Smart TV
- 650 square feet

PARKING:
- Very limited paid parking is available on-site. $35/night + taxes. Parking fees will be collected online in your booking virtual check in. We recommend reserving early or planning for nearby garages.

We have multiple units in this building, and each one is unique. Decor and layout may vary slightly from what you see in photos

Guest access
BUILDING AMENITIES:
- Lounge area
- Luggage lockers
- Elevator

WHAT YOU CAN COUNT ON:
We handle every part of your stay so you get reliable, professional service with the freedom of a self-directed experience.

- 24/7 virtual support by text, chat, email, or phone
- Walkable location near Nashville's top attractions
- Professional cleaning between every stay
- Thoughtfully designed interiors built for comfort
- Secure ID verification at booking
- In-unit noise and smoke monitoring for a safe, quiet stay

Other things to note
PLEASE NOTE:

Before you arrive:
- REQUIRED FOR ALL GUESTS: Complete the check-in form we send you. Your unit number, door code, and access instructions will be sent only after the form is submitted.
- The form covers ID verification, a criminal background check, a valid credit or debit card for incidentals, early check-in requests, and parking/pet fees.
- Reservations cannot be completed if the background check returns disqualifying criminal records. If this affects your booking, you'll be notified promptly upon completion of your check-in form.
- Age requirement: guests must be 22+ to book and check in, or 25+ if booking locally (within 50 miles of the property).
- Payments for optional services not related to the cost of the room (like parking) will be collected via major credit or debit card by the company providing the service.

Pets
- One pet allowed per unit, with registration required before arrival through your check-in form.
- Pet fee: $8–$30 per night depending on length of stay

Parking
- On-site paid parking is very limited: $35/night plus tax, collected through your check-in form. We recommend reserving early or planning for nearby garages.

Housekeeping
- No mid-stay cleanings are included. Additional cleanings can be scheduled on request for a fee.

Unit Appearance
- While the photos accurately represent the layout and category of the unit you booked, the specific furniture, décor, and actual lighting may vary slightly from unit to unit.
